cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Stay for the Hard Part
cards.instruction: Create increasing moments of emotional honesty to test whether someone remains present and supportive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll clear this up before we go back into the reunion. I wasn't just late.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I saved you a seat beside me. Was it the traffic?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No. I waited outside for half an hour. I'll come back in with you, but hear me first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm listening. I thought you didn't want to sit with me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I wanted that seat. I was afraid you'd be happier without me. Will you take me to it?

reason: State the present location and next action in the dialogue; A offers returning with B to secure a hearing, then reveals the deeper fear and asks B to accompany A to the saved seat.
